LEADER: the 20-F's Item 7.A table (as of March 1, 2026) gives Vélez's holding by class (0.1% of Class A, 88.3% of Class B) and his voting power (74.4%) but not a percentage of all shares, so pctEconomic is null and leader.derived gives 18.64% from the stated counts, for an editor to approve. His figure includes 1,500,000 Class B shares held by his wife and the shares of Rua California Ltd., which the 20-F also lists separately as a 5% holder; Rua California is not added as a holder because it is inside his figure. HOLDERS: largestHolders is null. The other 5% holders are given only as percentages of Class A, not of all shares, and are not converted here: BlackRock 266,236,594 Class A (6.9%, 13G filed November 8, 2024) and Baillie Gifford & Co 265,160,474 (6.9%, 13G filed April 30, 2025); Sequoia and Capital Research no longer appear. Co-founder Cristina Junqueira holds 11,427,060 Class A (0.3%) and 119,476,200 Class B (11.7%), 9.9% of votes. STOCK COMP: 0.33 is Nu's 'Total share-based compensation expenses' for 2025 ($329.5 million). It includes related corporate and social security taxes and a $29.5 million hedge fair-value adjustment. The cash-flow add-back for share-based payments is $271.8 million. GEOGRAPHY: the geographic table totals $12.08 billion, below the $15.77 billion total revenue in the income statement, because it covers only the revenue types listed in its footnote; the 20-F does not reconcile the two totals.
